justification: Although the case concerns peaceful assembly complaints under Article 11, the Court does not conduct a standalone Article 11 merits analysis but instead disposes of the Article 11 complaints by reference to well-established case-law in a single summary paragraph (§13), without a formal finding of 'violation of Article 11' as a distinct operative holding — the Article 11 findings are subsumed into a generic 'other complaints under well-established case-law' category rather than expressed as an independent Article 11 merits conclusion.
